fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' {{tip|blinks}} from his current location to up to 475 units towards the target location, then fires a homing bolt towards the nearest enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for 1 second.
fields.description2: ''Arcane Shift'' prioritizes firing at the nearest enemy marked by ''{{ai|Essence Flux|Ezreal}}''.
fields.description3: ''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''
